client.business_model: Multi-facility regional distributor of fresh produce and specialty food products serving foodservice and retail customers across the Mid-West, South and Southeast United States.
client.client_history: FreshEdge was formed in 2019 when IF&P Foods (Indianapolis Fruit and Piazza Produce) merged with Get Fresh Produce. Backed initially by Rotunda Capital Partners and acquired by Wind Point Partners in October 2022, the company has executed multiple add-on acquisitions and now ranks among the largest independent fresh-food distributors in the U.S.

revenue.notes: Two third-party estimate sites provide drastically different figures ($42.8M vs $254.3M) and no primary source could be found. Because of the wide discrepancy and lack of official confirmation, revenue is left null.

locations.source: thepacker.com article, July 2024 (“over 1.3 million sq ft across 35 facilities”); earlier ProduceNews.com piece (Jan 2023) cited 25 facilities
locations.notes: Most recent source (ThePacker, 2024) indicates 35 facilities; earlier count of 25 likely predates 2023-24 acquisitions.

employees.notes: Employee count reported as ~2,800 following successive acquisitions. Earlier sources (2022) noted 2,000+, indicating steady growth.
